prior_calibration: Each cell's own preceding C/20 discharge and HPPC 1C; 25C pulse rest curve for OCV approximation; temperature lookup uses chamber setpoint
fixed_rc_selection: Fixed initial RC selected by prior 6-cell evaluation; no within-window RC change
selection: Select lowest development EKF SOC proxy RMSE with one-step voltage RMSE no more than 1.1 times the 1e-8 baseline; before decoding new test drive voltages; raw bytes are read for checksum verification
drive_windows: 600 seconds beginning at 20% and 60% of each active WLTP, UDDS, US06 recording; per-second charge-preserving resampling
pulse_holdout: Separate HPPC C/3 discharge pulses nearest SOC proxies 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7, with 5 seconds preceding rest and 115 seconds including/after pulse
reference: Slow-discharge voltage anchor at each driving start and integrated current/capacity; pulse reference assumes full charge at HPPC start; neither is an independent direct SOC measurement
initialization: Each window intentionally initializes estimator at its SOC proxy minus 0.04; zero RC voltage; controlled recovery test, not a blind-start SOC benchmark
one_step_voltage: The prior voltage is computed before the voltage observation at that same time, but earlier observations are used
open_loop_voltage: No measured voltage is used after the proxy-based window initialization; current and chamber setpoint are supplied
eis: Processed EIS measured after the driving sequence is checked and catalogued only; it is not treated as a prior model calibration
exposure_note: One 60644/25C C/3 pulse was inspected for data and code integrity after q was frozen; no parameter selection used that pulse. The full driving test was run once then reproduced unchanged.
